items.q: Where does Arnav Khandelwal study and what experience does he have?
items.a: Arnav Khandelwal is pursuing a B.Tech in Electrical Engineering at Malaviya National Institute of Technology Jaipur, with study beginning in August 2023. His résumé lists a Backend Engineering Internship at Dehurdle from June to August 2026, where he built Project Edge Node. These biographical details come from his owner-supplied résumé; public project measurements are checked against repository evidence.
